service_boundary.intra_hour_check: Under constant hourly forcing and controls, exact first-order RC trajectory is monotone between checked boundary states. This is not sub-hour disturbances/device ramp validation.

comparison_cost_semantics: CAPEX + F*(120-day electricity energy charges + explicitly assumed fixed window OM), F=5 at main four-row comparison; no annualisation. Values exclude unknown costs described below and must retain comparison label.

unpriced_boundaries_not_zero.interpretation: Common equal costs would cancel ranking but are not zero or known. Differential excluded costs must modify thresholds; they cannot be asserted equal for an actual project without evidence. Research-budget costs already included do not close real costs.

thresholds.price_axis_method: For each n=0/1/2 compute exact LP optimum affine cost line C_n(P)=b_n+nP; the lower envelope gives all registered package-price decision intervals without fabricating a vendor price range. thresholds.correction_equation: HP1 vs no-HP purchase condition: P <= 9346.483316642709 - delta_K - 5*delta_OM. delta terms are additional differential costs outside the declared comparison ledger, unknown for real project.

thresholds.repeat_crossing_scope: Equality of the two fixed F5-optimal plans only; globally reoptimised four-factor table shows HP0 at1/5 andHP1 at12/20. Not an exact universal lifetime/payback threshold.

epsilon_result.compromise_rule: Predeclared middle cap among5 uniformly spaced endpoint CO2 caps; no claim of a normative recommendation or knee. Repeated feasible points are retained.

quality.audit_scope: Independent arithmetic/chronology/physical feasibility, actual candidate-scope/fixed asset snapshot/enumeration coverage/statuses, and lower bounds recomputed from reported primary duals. Dual vectors/LP optimality are not independently certified; no actual FT performance/field validity claim.

exact_engineering_admission_remaining: FT8 same-model versioned actual/test capacity and electrical-input/COP table at ambient/water flow/inlet/outlet conditions, including defrost and minimum part-load/auxiliary measurement boundary

completed_work_not_changed: This investment work did not edit old E0/TOU/common-window admissions, heatplan core, frozen rc4, main README, PPT/PDF or Git/tag/upload state; main coordinator independently owns upload decisions.
how_to_use: Use the conditional price/extra-cost/operating-window design map to decide which documented quotes/performance conditions would support a choice. Do not present scenario COP or price thresholds as actual FT engineering savings.

bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.baseline: Only [0] is enumerated and its bound is scoped as baseline_no_HP; cannot be used as unrestricted [0,1,2] bound.
bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.free_investment: All and only registered effective candidates enumerated exactly once; protocol/summary/enum jointly checked.
bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.fixed_replay: Each actual HP count, resistance capacity and cooling capacity fixed and exported explicitly; bound applies only to that fixed snapshot.
bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.primary_infeasible: Only a sole primary stage status 2 is accepted as proven infeasible for that candidate.
bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.secondary_failure: Primary status 0 followed by any nonzero secondary status returns no definite endpoint and enumeration_complete=false; keeps primary metrics, solution SHA and valid primary lower bound.
bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.unresolved_primary: Timeout/error or unresolved primary status causes null global lower bound and incomplete enumeration.
bound_scope_and_solver_failure_fixes.counterexample_identity: 9000 CNY is a hypothetical stress price, not a newly verified FT8 quote. Full 2880h: scoped baseline lower bound14402.378752879542 exceeds feasible unrestricted HP1 cost14055.895439392752, demonstrating why scope must be explicit.

portable_source_contract.default_mode: Numerical reproduction verifies all registered processed inputs and source records; absent original PDFs do not block the solver.
portable_source_contract.strict_mode: --verify-original-sources checks only explicitly registered original files (this investment bundle: FT8 original contract), and fails before solver if missing or mismatched. It does not freshly audit all inherited building/weather/tariff raw sources.

prior_export_status.old_scope_issue: Prior run_01/run_02/reproduce_01 do not have the corrected effective bound_scope records and are rejected by the current stricter auditor; preserve as earlier evidence, not current scope-certified outputs.
prior_export_status.old_source_issue: Old numerical manifests/locks are preserved unchanged even if publication excludes original PDFs. Do not rewrite them to claim absent PDFs were freshly verified.
